title: Quiz: Understanding Python Namespace Packages
description: Test your understanding of Python namespace packages, how they differ from regular packages, and how to build, publish, and install them with uv.
summary: In this quiz, you’ll test your understanding of Understanding Python Namespace Packages . By working through this quiz, you’ll revisit what namespace packages are, how they differ from regular packages, and why they’re a good fit for large collections of related packages.
takeaways: You’ll also review how Python combines same-named folders into one namespace, how to configure uv to build a namespace package, and how to publish its members to TestPyPI and install them independently.
